# streamsec_aws_scanner_access_ack (Resource)

Acknowledges that an AWS account (a spoke) has the `StreamScannerSpokeRole` a hub's scanner assumes to scan it, as the CloudFormation scanner access stack does. Destroying it reports the role uninstalled. Used by the `volume-scanner-access` module of `terraform-streamsec-aws-account`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The volume-scanner-access module of terraform-streamsec-aws-account creates this
# in the spoke account once its StreamScannerSpokeRole exists.
resource "streamsec_aws_scanner_access_ack" "dev" {
  hub_account_id         = streamsec_aws_scanner_hub.security.account_id
  spoke_cloud_account_id = "444455556666"

  depends_on = [aws_iam_role.stream_scanner_spoke]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hub_account_id` (String) The Stream Security id of the hub's AWS account (`streamsec_aws_scanner_hub.<name>.account_id`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `spoke_cloud_account_id` (String) The 12-digit AWS account id of the spoke the role is in. Changing it replaces the resource.
